complexity: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space; each successful swap places a value at its final value-index position.
domain_status: Author-declared domain based on reviewed permitted reference semantics. Frozen normative statement/type/effect/complexity contract alignment is unresolved unless separately established by independent qualification; finite case parity cannot repair missing normative domain authority.
evidence_boundary: Source-only authoring and ast.parse syntax evidence. No candidate was imported or executed during authoring; no dev_val case/expected payload or validation literal-cost result was read. Reference semantics are compatibility context, not an independent correctness oracle. No admission, behavioral qualification, fixed500 coverage, M1/M2 milestone completion or protected generalization is claimed. Independent source-bound isolated execution with frozen host oracle, strict types/effects/aliases, resource limits and normative contract alignment remains required.
mutation_aliasing: Mutates the supplied list in place through deterministic index-order cyclic swaps. List identity is preserved; no new caller-visible container is returned. Exact final permutation is an effect obligation, not merely multiset parity.
numeric: Ordinary Python int/float values as explicitly declared in input; bool is not accepted as an integer. No NaN, infinity or negative-zero identity contract is silently introduced. Numeric operations are exact only under the per-problem bounds; arbitrary-integer bit costs and Python/JavaScript rounding outside these bounds remain unresolved. Lists/strings/nodes are ordinary values without subclasses, getters or concurrent mutation.

provenance.authoring: Independently written Python algorithm and explicit reference-effect compatibility; no automated transpiler or runtime delegation.

return: Smallest positive integer absent from the list.
source_accounting: The entire standalone 448-byte UTF-8 source is charged, including solve entrypoint, every helper/class/constructor, imports and built-in calls, constants, identifiers, whitespace and final newline. Explicit standard-library calls do not hide problem-specific source and their runtime/temporary costs are included in complexity. No JavaScript source/runtime, generated implementation, implicit node constructors, hidden table, source escape, or external dependency is provided. Any future adapter bytes must be additionally charged.
